title: RD Executive Transportation Worldwide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The driver will guide the tour/No tour guide (this tour is not a lectured tour)
The 4:00pm evening tour is also a 4hr tour and is not a lectured tour and ends at 8pm.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: On this tour the travelers will experience a large amount of Washington DCs historic landmarks. On our private tour shuttle travelers will be taken from one attraction and be able to get off for 25 to 30 minutes and to another. Travelers will be provided water and the shuttle van has luggage space for travelers with extra belongings. Travelers also can arrange pickup location inside of Washington DC area.
